description: Get one build's whole symbol table as a file, to analyse with code (Python, pandas, DuckDB, jq) when the other tools cannot answer the question. Returns a one-time download, not the symbols: run the returned 'command' in a shell to save the file, then work on the file, so the table never enters the conversation. Needs a shell that can reach the MemBrowse server.

project.description: The project: a public project's GitHub 'owner/repo' (no API key needed), or, with an API key, a project id or name from list_projects.

ref.description: The build: a full commit SHA, a SHA prefix (7+ characters), or a branch or tag name. Default: the head of the default branch.

name: export_symbols
title: Export symbol table
